edits.old: And a build rule fails a class of the service that names a data-lake endpoint, the INT-19 identification or a lake container
edits.new:
And a build rule fails a class of the service that names a data-lake endpoint, the INT-19 identification or a lake container

  Scenario: AC9 The rules BR6, BR8, BR9, BR10, BR11, BR12, BR13 and BR14 of section 8 are held by build guardrails and component tests (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the build of rwb-source-data is checked against the rules of section 8
    When a class of the service reads or writes measure_definition or measure_snapshot
    Then the build fails
    When a class of the service names a data-lake endpoint or writes an extract file
    Then the build fails
    When a message text is written as a literal in code instead of being raised by its ID from the message standard
    Then the build fails
    When a data job for a business date is started before the ALS batch of that date is COMPLETE
    Then the job is refused and no data job starts
    When a repeat readiness call for a business date is made
    Then it answers 202, publishes nothing and starts nothing

  Scenario: AC10 The provided operations answer 401 for a call without a caller identity, 403 for a caller without the role of the operation and 404 for a business date with no readiness record (new, D-RCV-60)
    When GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/payments?accountId=ACC0000017 is called without a caller identity
    Then the call answers 401 and no payment row is returned
    When the same call is made by a caller who does not hold case record read
    Then the call answers 403 and no payment row is returned
    When GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/business-days/{businessDate}/status is called for a business date for which no readiness record exists
    Then the call answers 404

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the state model does not allow is refused and leaves the readiness record unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the readiness record of business date 2026-11-27 holds the state DONE
    When a status change that the state model does not allow is requested for 2026-11-27
    Then the change is refused and the state DONE is unchanged
    And no event is written to the outbox and no workflow is started
